text: Most items can be returned within 30 days of delivery, and Fernwick Plus members have 60 days [6]. If you received the wrong item, you have 14 days to send it back [1].
Express shipping takes 2 business days and costs $14.95 [1].
Standard shipping is free on orders of $50 or more, after discounts [1].
Orders placed before 2:00 PM Eastern Time on a business day ship the same day, so an order at 4pm would miss that cut-off [1]. Orders placed after that time ship the next business day [1].

You can cancel an order yourself within 60 minutes of placing it by opening Account, then Orders, and selecting Cancel [1]. After 60 minutes the order has usually gone to the warehouse and can no longer be changed [1].

We ship to Canada [2]. International delivery takes 7 to 14 business days and costs $24.95 per order [2]. Import duties and taxes are not included in the price and are paid by the recipient on delivery [2].

Check around your property, with neighbours and with your building's mailroom, then wait 1 business day, since carriers sometimes mark parcels early [1]. If it still has not appeared, report it within 14 days of the delivery date so we can file a claim [1].
Gift wrapping costs $4.95 per item and is added at checkout [1].

Open Account, then Orders, select the item and choose Return [1]. Print the prepaid label, pack the item, attach the label and drop the parcel at any carrier location [1]. You do not need to contact support to start a normal return [1].
Yes, for a return of an item you simply don't want, a $6.95 label fee is deducted from your refund [3]. The fee is waived if you are a Fernwick Plus member or if you choose store credit [3].

We inspect returns within 2 business days of arrival and then issue the refund to your original payment method [1]. Banks usually take 5 to 10 business days to show it [1]. Store credit is available immediately after inspection [1].
Damaged items must be reported within 7 days of delivery, with a photo of the item and the packaging [1]. We will then send a free replacement or give a full refund, your choice [1].
Fernwick-branded furniture has a 5 year warranty against manufacturing defects [1]. Other brands are covered by their maker's warranty instead [1].

We accept Visa, Mastercard, American Express, Discover, Apple Pay, Google Pay, PayPal and Fernwick gift cards [1]. We do not accept personal checks, cash on delivery or cryptocurrency [1]. Orders between $75 and $1,500 can also be split into 4 interest-free payments taken every 2 weeks [2].
Your card is authorised when you place the order and charged when the order ships [1]. For backordered and pre-order items, your card is charged when the item ships, not when you order [2].
Go to Account, then Payment methods, and select Add card or Remove [1]. To change the card used for your Fernwick Plus renewal, set the new card as Default [1].

Payments are usually declined because the billing address does not match the one held by the bank, the card has expired, or the bank has blocked the purchase [1]. You can check your details, try another card or payment method, or ask your bank to approve the transaction [1].
Gift cards never expire and have no fees [1].
No, only one promo code can be used per order [1]. Codes also cannot be added after the order has been placed [1].

Yes, if the price dropped within 14 days of your purchase, contact support and we will refund the difference as store credit [1]. Price adjustments do not apply to clearance, lightning deals or other retailers' prices [1].

The reset link is valid for 30 minutes [1].
Your account is locked for 15 minutes after 5 failed sign-in attempts [1]. You can wait the 15 minutes or reset your password to unlock it right away [1].

Turn on two-step verification under Account, then Security [1]. You can use an authenticator app or text message codes [1]. Save the 10 recovery codes shown during setup, because each code works once if you lose your phone [1].
Go to Account, then Membership, then Cancel [1]. Your benefits continue until the end of the period you have paid for, and the membership does not renew [1].
New members get a 30 day free trial [1]. Each household can use one trial [1].
Unplug the desk for 30 seconds, then plug it back in [1]. Next, hold the down button until the desk reaches its lowest point and beeps [1]. The desk is ready to use after the beep [1].
The Rise standing desk supports up to 120 kg (265 lb) [1].

The Perch monitor arm fits screens up to 34 inches, so a 32 inch screen is within its limit [1]. The screen must also weigh no more than 9 kg (19.8 lb) and have a VESA 75 x 75 mm or 100 x 100 mm mount [1].

Switch the keyboard on, then hold Fn and 1, 2 or 3 for 3 seconds until the light blinks [1]. Next, select Quill Keyboard in your laptop's Bluetooth settings [1]. The keyboard remembers up to 3 devices [1].

Check that the mute switch on the left ear cup is off and that the headset is selected as the input device in your computer's sound settings [1]. If the microphone is still silent, update the headset firmware with the Murmur app [1]. For the update, connect the headset with its USB cable, keep it plugged in, and expect it to take about 5 minutes [2].
Our support team is available on Saturday from 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM [1].

Your card is authorised when you place the order and charged when the order ships [1]. For backordered and pre-order items, your card is charged when the item ships, not when you order [2].
You can add a company name and tax ID to future invoices under Account, then Billing details [1].

We inspect returns within 2 business days of arrival and then refund your original payment method, which banks usually show after 5 to 10 business days [1]. Store credit is available immediately after inspection [1]. For non-faulty returns, a $6.95 label fee is deducted from your refund, but it is waived for Fernwick Plus members and when you choose store credit [3].

We inspect returns within 2 business days of arrival and then issue the refund to your original payment method [2]. Banks usually take 5 to 10 business days to show it [2]. Store credit is available immediately after inspection [2].

Returns are free for faulty, damaged or incorrect items, but for other returns a $6.95 label fee is deducted from your refund [1]. The fee is waived for Fernwick Plus members and when you choose store credit [1].

Payments are usually declined because the billing address does not match the one held by the bank, the card has expired, or the bank has blocked the purchase [1]. You can check the details, try another card or payment method, or ask your bank to approve the transaction [1].

No, you will not be charged the shipping fee twice, since the shipping fee is charged only once when an order arrives in separate parcels [3]. Your card is charged when the order ships, after being authorised when you place the order [2].

Fernwick Goods never asks for your password or full card number by email, text or phone, and official emails come from addresses ending in @fernwick.example [1]. If you receive a suspicious message, do not click its links; forward it to security@fernwick.example [1].

Turn on two-step verification under Account, then Security, using either an authenticator app or text message codes [1]. Be sure to save the 10 recovery codes shown during setup, since each code works once if you lose your phone [1].
Go to Account, then Privacy, then Download my data to request a copy of your account data [1]. The file is emailed to you within 7 days [1].

You can close your account under Account, then Privacy, then Close account [1]. Closing becomes permanent after 30 days, and signing in during that time cancels the request [1]. Unused store credit is lost when the account is permanently closed [1].
Check that the height lever returns fully to its resting position [1]. If the Tern chair still sinks, make a warranty claim and we will send a replacement gas lift [1].

If tracking shows no movement for 3 business days, or your parcel is more than 3 business days past the estimated date, contact support and we will open a carrier trace [1]. A trace takes up to 5 business days [1]. If the carrier confirms the parcel is lost, we send a replacement or refund the order [1].
Report the wrong item within 14 days of delivery [1]. We ship the correct item right away and send a free prepaid label for the wrong one [1]. You then have 14 days to send the wrong item back [1].
An annual membership fee is refunded in full if you cancel within 14 days of the charge and have not used any Plus benefit in that period [1]. Monthly fees are not refunded [1].

Yes, you can add a company name and tax ID under Account, then Billing details, and they will appear on future invoices [1]. You can then download a PDF invoice for any order from Account, then Orders, then Invoice [1].

No, you do not need to contact support to start a normal return [1]. Open Account, then Orders, select the item and choose Return, then print the prepaid label and drop the parcel at any carrier location [1].
Wipe the desktop with a soft damp cloth and dry it straight away [2]. Use coasters for hot mugs, and avoid abrasive cleaners [2].
No, the warranty covers manufacturing defects only and does not cover accidental damage, normal wear or unauthorised repairs [1].

Sales tax is calculated from your delivery address and shown at checkout before you pay [1]. Tax-exempt organisations can apply by uploading an exemption certificate under Account, then Tax settings, and review takes 2 business days [1]. You can also add a company name and tax ID to future invoices under Account, then Billing details [2].
